moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Invert Success Premise
moves.signature: Reframe the domain's celebrated outcome (success) as the hidden cause of a catastrophic vulnerability.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Performance Gap Mapping
moves.signature: Plot two trajectories on the same axis to reveal the moment an inferior entrant crosses the incumbent's line.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Stakeholder Capture Diagnosis
moves.signature: Identify how loyalty to the current power-holder blinds the actor to signals from outside that constituency.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Resource Allocation Trap
moves.signature: Show how rational internal investment decisions systematically starve the threat that will later prove fatal.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Dual Entry Vector Split
moves.signature: Distinguish two structurally different attack routes—low-end displacement and entirely new-market creation—to prevent conflation.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Cross-Domain Pattern Lock
moves.signature: Repeat the same structural mechanism across unrelated industries to isolate the mechanism from any single context.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Mechanism Extraction
moves.signature: Strip away domain-specific detail to name the underlying causal engine that operates across all observed cases.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Asymmetric Improvement Rate
moves.signature: Establish that the challenger's rate of change exceeds the incumbent's, making current inferiority a temporary and misleading signal.
moves.anchor: worse performance than incumbents but improve faster

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Rational-Action Paradox
moves.signature: Demonstrate that the losing actor's choices were locally optimal yet globally self-defeating, removing moral blame and exposing structural inevitability.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Framework Crystallization
moves.signature: Consolidate the recurring pattern into a named, portable model that can be applied prospectively rather than only retrospectively.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Profitability Source Reframe
moves.signature: Relocates the explanatory target from internal attributes to external structural conditions.
moves.anchor: Industry profitability determined by five forces

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Force Enumeration
moves.signature: Partitions a complex phenomenon into a fixed, exhaustive set of discrete causal agents.
moves.anchor: rivalry among competitors, threat of new entrants, threat of substitutes, bargaining power of suppli

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Structural Decomposition
moves.signature: Breaks a unified domain into constituent components whose individual characterization enables aggregate prediction.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Force Characterization
moves.signature: Assigns descriptive properties to each enumerated agent to establish its intensity and direction.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Configuration Reading
moves.signature: Treats the combined state of all components as a pattern whose gestalt predicts an outcome.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Outcome Derivation
moves.signature: Derives a measurable result as a downstream consequence of the mapped structural arrangement.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Response Design
moves.signature: Translates a structural diagnosis into a prescriptive action oriented toward altering or exploiting the identified conditions.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Boundary Setting
moves.signature: Defines the unit of analysis explicitly so that the framework applies to a delimited arena rather than an unbounded field.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Leverage Point Identification
moves.signature: Locates the nodes within the structure where intervention yields disproportionate influence over the outcome.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Cross-Force Synthesis
moves.signature: Integrates findings across all enumerated components into a unified interpretive judgment.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Methodology Codification
moves.signature: Packages the sequence of analytical steps into a repeatable procedure transferable across instances.
moves.anchor: Methodology: decompose industry into structural components

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Disciplinary Boundary Crossing
moves.signature: Deliberately importing explanatory structures from outside one's home domain to reframe a problem.
moves.anchor: mental models from major disciplines (psychology, mathematics, biology, physics, economics)

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Repertoire Capping
moves.signature: Setting a finite, manageable ceiling on the number of core tools so the set remains operable rather than infinite.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Multi-Lens Triangulation
moves.signature: Applying several independent frameworks simultaneously to a single situation and reading where their outputs converge.
moves.anchor: Apply multiple models to any decision

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Convergence Amplification
moves.signature: Treating the simultaneous agreement of independent lines of reasoning as a signal of disproportionately higher confidence or force.
moves.anchor: lollapalooza effect when several models point same direction

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Cross-Domain Pattern Harvest
moves.signature: Scanning disparate fields specifically to extract recurring structural regularities that transfer across contexts.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Broad Intake Discipline
moves.signature: Sustaining a reading and learning practice that spans unrelated fields to continuously replenish the model repertoire.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Procedural Externalization
moves.signature: Encoding judgment steps into an explicit sequential list so cognitive load and omission risk are reduced under pressure.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Stakes-Gated Rigor
moves.signature: Reserving the most thorough analytical protocol for decisions whose consequences exceed a defined threshold.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Negative-Space Targeting
moves.signature: Orienting effort toward identifying and eliminating bad outcomes rather than directly pursuing good ones.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Outcome Reframing by Inversion
moves.signature: Restating a goal as its opposite to surface constraints and failure modes that forward-looking analysis misses.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Lattice Assembly
moves.signature: Organizing acquired models into an interconnected structure so each node reinforces and contextualizes the others.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Cross-Domain Pattern Harvest
moves.signature: Protagonist samples diverse real-world instances to extract a pattern that transcends any single context.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Abstraction Ladder Climb
moves.signature: Protagonist lifts concrete observations to a generalized framework, stripping domain-specific detail to reveal transferable structure.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Dual Alignment Reframe
moves.signature: Protagonist reframes a tension between two levels or parties as a solvable alignment problem rather than an inherent conflict.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Progress Made Visible
moves.signature: Protagonist installs a measurement mechanism so that movement toward a goal becomes legible and actionable.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Means-of-Production Shift
moves.signature: Protagonist identifies that the locus of productive power has migrated from external assets to internal, person-held capacity.
moves.anchor: workers who own means of production (knowledge)

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Era Boundary Declaration
moves.signature: Protagonist draws a historical threshold, asserting that prior rules no longer apply and a new operating logic has taken hold.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Practice-Over-Theory Inversion
moves.signature: Protagonist subordinates theoretical elegance to demonstrated applicability, judging ideas by what they enable practitioners to do.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Explicit Prescription Delivery
moves.signature: Protagonist converts analytical findings into direct, actionable recommendations rather than leaving implications implicit.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Recurring-Pattern Isolation
moves.signature: Protagonist scans multiple cases to identify a structural regularity that persists across surface variation.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Framework Portability Claim
moves.signature: Protagonist asserts that the abstracted structure applies beyond its origin context, inviting adoption in unrelated domains.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Normative Frame Rejection
moves.signature: The protagonist discards the prevailing ideal-standard model as the operative framework, replacing it with an empirically grounded alternative.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Reference Point Insertion
moves.signature: The protagonist introduces a relative baseline against which all outcomes are measured, shifting evaluation from absolute to differential.
moves.anchor: evaluate gains/losses relative to reference point

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Systematic Deviation Mapping
moves.signature: The protagonist catalogs consistent departures from the dominant model as the primary evidential material rather than treating them as noise.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Controlled Elicitation Design
moves.signature: The protagonist constructs minimal, repeatable decision tasks to isolate a single cognitive mechanism from confounding variables.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Asymmetry Foregrounding
moves.signature: The protagonist elevates an observed directional imbalance between two nominally equivalent quantities into a central explanatory principle.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Nonlinear Rescaling
moves.signature: The protagonist replaces a linear input-output mapping with a curved function that captures differential sensitivity across the input range.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Bias Quantification
moves.signature: The protagonist converts qualitative cognitive tendencies into measurable parameters embedded within a formal model.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Empirical Pattern Fitting
moves.signature: The protagonist constructs the model's architecture to conform to observed data rather than deriving predictions from first principles.
moves.anchor: build descriptive model fitting empirical patterns

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Domain Boundary Redraw
moves.signature: The protagonist redefines the scope of the field by distinguishing what the model is meant to describe from what it is meant to prescribe.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Dual-Outcome Framing
moves.signature: The protagonist structures the problem space around two opposing outcome categories to expose differential responses that a unified treatment would obscure.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Reframe Core Concept
moves.signature: The protagonist replaces a dominant single definition with a richer, multi-faceted set of definitions that expose hidden dimensions of the subject.
moves.anchor: Five Ps: plan, ploy, pattern, position, perspective

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Expose Received Wisdom Gap
moves.signature: The protagonist identifies a widely held assumption and demonstrates empirically that practice systematically diverges from it.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Invert Causality Arrow
moves.signature: The protagonist reverses the assumed direction of cause and effect, showing that outcomes precede and generate the principles attributed to them.
moves.anchor: strategy emerges from organizational action over time

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Legitimize the Residual
moves.signature: The protagonist elevates what was previously treated as noise, deviation, or failure into a recognized and valued category of the phenomenon.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Dual-Source Synthesis
moves.signature: The protagonist resolves an apparent opposition by arguing that both poles are necessary components of a functional whole rather than rivals.
moves.anchor: effective strategy combines deliberate intent and emergent learning

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Longitudinal Evidence Shift
moves.signature: The protagonist replaces cross-sectional or theoretical evidence with time-extended observation to reveal processes invisible in snapshots.
moves.anchor: longitudinal case studies of strategy formation

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Descriptive Over Prescriptive
moves.signature: The protagonist repositions the field's goal from telling practitioners what to do toward accurately describing what actually occurs.
moves.anchor: descriptive empirical strategy theory; reject prescriptive planning models

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Pattern Extraction Move
moves.signature: The protagonist identifies coherent structure not in stated intentions but in the accumulated trace of repeated actions across time.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Institutional Critique
moves.signature: The protagonist targets a dominant professional practice or formal system and argues it systematically produces the failure it claims to prevent.

moves.author: sonnet
moves.name: Temporal Recontextualization
moves.signature: The protagonist reframes a static object as a dynamic process by insisting it can only be understood across an extended time horizon.
moves.anchor: strategy is not just deliberate planning; emerges over time

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Isolate Core Anomaly
moves.signature: Identify a recurring, paradoxical outcome that defies conventional wisdom.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Assemble Comparative Set
moves.signature: Select a diverse set of instances exhibiting the same core anomaly to enable cross-case analysis.
moves.anchor: case studies (disk drives, steel mills, retailing)

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Extract Repeating Pattern
moves.signature: Discern a common sequence of events or relationships that appears across multiple independent instances.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Model Competing Trajectories
moves.signature: Define the system by the opposing or intersecting developmental paths of its key components.
moves.anchor: worse performance than incumbents but improve faster

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Frame Local Optimum Trap
moves.signature: Explain a systemic failure as the result of agents rationally pursuing their immediate, localized incentives.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Pinpoint Reinforcing Loop
moves.signature: Identify the primary activity that reinforces the existing system's structure and prevents adaptation.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Delineate Sub-Types
moves.signature: Classify a general phenomenon into distinct variants based on their entry mechanism or target.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Articulate Causal Engine
moves.signature: Propose the underlying causal process that generates the observed pattern of outcomes.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Abstract to General Framework
moves.signature: Elevate a specific explanation into a portable, abstract model applicable to other domains.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Adopt Governing Model
moves.signature: Select a pre-defined framework to explain the dynamics of a complex system.
moves.anchor: Industry profitability determined by five forces

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Decompose Into Factors
moves.signature: Break down a complex whole into a discrete set of constituent elements or influences.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Enumerate Core Elements
moves.signature: List the specific, named components dictated by the chosen framework.
moves.anchor: rivalry among competitors, threat of new entrants, threat of substitutes, bargaining power of suppli

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Characterize Each Component
moves.signature: Assess the state, intensity, or nature of each identified element in isolation.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Synthesize System Configuration
moves.signature: Combine the individual component assessments to form a holistic understanding of the system's current structure.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Predict System Outcome
moves.signature: Use the synthesized understanding of the system's structure to forecast a key result or behavior.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Design Responsive Action
moves.signature: Develop a course of action based on the structural analysis to achieve a desired outcome.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Label The Method
moves.signature: Assign a formal label to the overall method of inquiry and action.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Constructing a Cognitive Toolkit
moves.signature: Intentionally assemble a personal library of fundamental concepts to be used for problem-solving.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Broad Spectrum Sourcing
moves.signature: Consume information from a wide variety of fields to build a robust intellectual toolkit.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Multi-Lens Analysis
moves.signature: Deliberately examine a single problem through several distinct conceptual viewpoints before forming a conclusion.
moves.anchor: Apply multiple models to any decision

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Convergent Signal Amplification
moves.signature: Identify and prioritize outcomes indicated by the convergence of multiple, independent analytical frameworks.
moves.anchor: lollapalooza effect when several models point same direction

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Cross-Domain Synthesis
moves.signature: Actively seek out and connect underlying patterns that recur across disparate areas of knowledge.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Triangulating from Principles
moves.signature: Validate a conclusion by ensuring it is supported by several independent, fundamental principles.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Procedural Scaffolding
moves.signature: Formalize a sequence of analytical steps into a repeatable protocol for critical situations.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Inverting the Problem
moves.signature: Reframe a goal from achieving success to systematically avoiding sources of failure.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Isolate Recurring Pattern
moves.signature: Identify a consistent structure or behavior by observing multiple, seemingly disparate instances.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Sample Diverse Contexts
moves.signature: Collect evidence from a wide range of environments to establish the generality of a phenomenon.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Construct Abstract Model
moves.signature: Build a simplified representation of a complex system to explain its core dynamics and relationships.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Generalize Specific Instances
moves.signature: Distill a set of specific observations into a universal model or principle that can be applied elsewhere.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Synchronize Component Goals
moves.signature: Create a mechanism that aligns the objectives of individual agents with the overarching goals of the system.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Define Progress Metrics
moves.signature: Establish clear, quantifiable indicators to track movement toward a desired state.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Identify New Power Source
moves.signature: Recognize and articulate a fundamental shift in the primary resource or control mechanism within a system.
moves.anchor: workers who own means of production (knowledge)

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Prioritize Practical Application
moves.signature: Value actionable implementation and observable results more highly than purely theoretical constructs.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Formulate Actionable Directives
moves.signature: Translate a general model or insight into specific, prescriptive actions for others to follow.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Establish New Field
moves.signature: Synthesize disparate observations and principles to create a novel and coherent domain of inquiry.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Displace The Incumbent
moves.signature: Propose a new explanatory framework intended to supersede a dominant, established theory.
moves.anchor: Replaced expected utility theory with prospect theory

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Establish A Relative Datum
moves.signature: Define outcomes not in absolute terms but in relation to a contextual, shifting baseline.
moves.anchor: evaluate gains/losses relative to a reference point

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Isolate An Asymmetric Response
moves.signature: Identify a consistent, unequal reaction to stimuli that are superficially opposites.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Model Subjective Distortion
moves.signature: Account for the non-linear way actors internally represent objective external values.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Construct Choice Architectures
moves.signature: Design controlled, hypothetical scenarios to elicit and observe decision-making processes.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Systematize The Anomalies
moves.signature: Treat recurring exceptions to a rule not as noise but as a coherent pattern requiring its own explanation.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Swap 'Ought' For 'Is'
moves.signature: Shift the theoretical goal from prescribing ideal behavior to describing actual behavior.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Build From Empirical Fit
moves.signature: Develop a model primarily based on its ability to match observed, real-world data patterns.
moves.anchor: build descriptive model fitting empirical patterns

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Measure Predictable Error
moves.signature: Assign formal, quantitative measures to consistent, non-rational patterns of judgment.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Exposing Framework Brittleness
moves.signature: Reveal the practical failures of a prevailing theoretical model.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Codifying Organic Formation
moves.signature: Articulate a new model where structure arises from accumulated actions rather than from a pre-ordained design.
moves.anchor: emerges from organizational action over time

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Decomposing a Monolith
moves.signature: Reframe a singular concept as a multi-faceted system of interacting components.
moves.anchor: Five Ps: plan, ploy, pattern, position, perspective

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Synthesizing Intent and Emergence
moves.signature: Create a hybrid model that combines directed planning with adaptive, responsive learning.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Tracking Evolution Over Time
moves.signature: Observe a system's behavior across a long duration to identify developmental patterns.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Highlighting Intent-Outcome Gap
moves.signature: Isolate a persistent discrepancy between stated goals and realized results.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Shifting to Descriptive Theory
moves.signature: Change the analytical focus from how a system should work to how it actually does.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Rejecting Prescriptive Models
moves.signature: Abandon idealized instructions in favor of models that reflect observed reality.

moves.author: gemini
moves.name: Finding Signal in Action
moves.signature: Identify a coherent, underlying pattern within a stream of discrete actions.
